name: Regression Analysis Checklist
description: This module is a pre-completion checklist for regression analysis work: a short set of checks to run before calling a regression analysis task done.
content:
This module is a pre-completion checklist for regression analysis work: a short set of checks to run before calling a regression analysis task done.

CORE GUIDELINES
1. When multiple regression analysis strategies are viable, name the trade-off explicitly rather than silently picking one.
2. Validate regression analysis outputs against a concrete example before treating the work as complete.
3. Prefer the simplest regression analysis approach that satisfies the requirement over a more general one that isn't needed yet.
4. Surface known limitations of a chosen regression analysis approach instead of presenting it as complete when it is not.
5. Keep regression analysis changes scoped to what was asked; avoid unrelated cleanup in the same pass.
6. When regression analysis guidance conflicts with a specific user instruction, defer to the user's explicit instruction and note the conflict.
7. Keep regression analysis outputs reproducible: fix seeds, record versions, and avoid hidden non-determinism where it matters.
8. Measure before optimizing any regression analysis bottleneck; do not guess at what is slow.

COMMON PITFALLS TO AVOID
- Do not silently drop regression analysis edge cases to make an example look cleaner than the real system.
- Do not apply generic regression analysis advice without checking it fits the specific context at hand.
- Do not skip documenting regression analysis assumptions just because they seem obvious in the moment.
- Avoid mixing unrelated regression analysis concerns into a single change; keep each change focused.

CLOSING NOTE
These guidelines are a starting point for regression analysis, not an exhaustive rulebook — use judgment when a rule doesn't fit the situation.
